lines.speaker: Tuấn
lines.text: Linh, do you have a few minutes for a quick status update on the campaign?

lines.speaker: Linh
lines.text: Sure! Overall we're on track, but we hit a small roadblock with the design agency.

lines.speaker: Linh
lines.text: They're behind on the banner designs, so I wanted to give you a heads-up in case it delays the launch.

lines.speaker: Tuấn
lines.text: Thanks for the heads-up. How much delay are we talking about?

lines.speaker: Linh
lines.text: Maybe two or three days, if we don't course-correct soon.

lines.speaker: Tuấn
lines.text: Okay. What's the biggest bottleneck right now?

lines.speaker: Linh
lines.text: Honestly, it's their approval process — everything has to go through three people.

lines.speaker: Tuấn
lines.text: Got it. Do you have the bandwidth to follow up with them directly today?

lines.speaker: Linh
lines.text: Yes, I'll call them this afternoon and keep you in the loop.

lines.speaker: Tuấn
lines.text: Perfect. Can you send me a quick rundown by email after the call?

lines.speaker: Linh
lines.text: Of course, I'll send it before I leave.
